The hue sweep of the figure, 180 by 60 pixels: hue from 0 to 360 degrees across, saturation from 100 % at the top to 0 at the bottom, value 100 %. The settings not named are the defaults: saturation from 40 % and value from 30 %. A 60 degree range is a sixth of the hues, and saturation from 40 % keeps the top 60 % of the rows, so about 10 % of the image is selected.
